topography.project_purpose: Harbor is a DeFi protocol that provides yield-bearing synthetic assets and leveraged tokens by aggregating price feeds and rates. It enables users to gain exposure to various asset pairs (e.g., stETH, USDE, sUSDe) and stock indices through oracle-driven products.
topography.relationship_narrative: The oracle families (stETH Pairs, USDE Pairs, sUSDe Pairs, fxUSD Pairs, and Leveraged Token Oracles) all rely on the same aggregator infrastructure (HarborDoubleFeedAndRateAggregator_v1, HarborCustomFeedAndRateAggregator_v1, HarborSingleFeedAndRateAggregator_v1) deployed via ERC1967Proxy. The Harbor Core Infrastructure family provides the foundational proxy and likely governance/treasury contracts that manage these oracles and the overall protocol.
